paragraphs.html: Hi, I am Xu Wang, an undergraduate student majoring in Artificial Intelligence at Shandong Jianzhu University. My research interests lie in Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision, particularly controllable text generation, medical AI, object detection, and image classification.

I have published 20+ papers in venues including AAAI, ICASSP, and Information Processing & Management. My work on controllable paragraph generation has received recognition from science-fiction writers such as Yan Wu. I also proposed an ECG clinical reasoning benchmark that has been cited by works at ICLR 2026 and ICML 2026, and adopted by subsequent studies such as CARE-ECG. Related follow-up research has involved leading researchers including Wei Wang and Krishnendu Chakrabarty. The benchmark has also been recognized by the MiniMind open-source project. In addition, my work on oracle-bone inscription deduplication and fragment stitching won 2nd and 3rd place in the Tencent SSV AI+Oracle competition.

I have participated in two Provincial Undergraduate Innovation & Entrepreneurship Training Program projects and received over 100 awards and honors, including the CNCC 2024 Student Travel Award, ICASSP 2026 Student Travel Award, National Gold Award in ChuangQingChun 2025, Grand Prize in the Shandong Challenge Cup, and National First Prizes in the Lanqiao Cup and CRAIC 2025.
I serve as a reviewer for conferences including ICME, AVSS, and BIBE, as well as journals such as IEEE TKDE and Scientific Reports, and I am a student member of AAAI, CCF, and SDCAI.

Beyond research, I am a recognized NetEase Cloud Music playlist curator and music-review writer. My playlists have accumulated over 3 million plays, while my music reviews have received hundreds of thousands of likes. I also founded ICCV (I Code Computer Vision), a public account focused on sharing research papers and computer vision insights, with tens of thousands of cumulative reads.
